crevalle.definition:
n. The cavally or jurel.
n. The pompano (Trachynotus Carolinus).
crevalle.translation: n. 一种可供玩赏及食用的鱼(产于热带海域)

crevasse.translation:
n. 裂缝, (堤、坝等的)决口, 崩溃处
vt. 使有裂缝

crevasses.translation: n. 破口, 崩溃处, 裂缝( crevasse的复数形式 )

crevenette.translation: 色织华达呢, 华达呢类织物

crevet.definition: n. A crucible or melting pot; a cruset.

crevice.definition: n. a long narrow depression in a surface

crevice corrosion.translation: [化] 裂隙腐蚀; 接触腐蚀

creviced.definition:
a. Having a crevice or crevices; as, a creviced structure
   for storing ears of corn.

crevices.definition:
n. a long narrow depression in a surface
n. a long narrow opening
crevices.translation: n. （尤指岩石的）裂缝, 缺口( crevice的复数形式 )
